frozen_config.target: p(S, z, U, rho, beta, omega, lambda_rep, lambda_back, pi, P | x) proportional to prod_n w(S_n, z_n) p(U|rho) p(rho) p(beta) p(omega) p(lambda_rep) p(lambda_back) p(pi) p(P)
frozen_config.segmentation_weight: log pi[z_1] + sum_l log p_RFS(x[a_l:b_l] | U_{z_l}, scalars, epsilon) + (J-L) log(1-delta_B) + (L-1) log delta_B + sum_{l>=2} log P[z_{l-1}, z_l]

likelihood_branch.name: utility-weighted frontier
likelihood_branch.feasibility: F(x) = prod_{z precedes x} q(z), empty product 1
likelihood_branch.utility: Q(x) = log(1 + S(x)),  S(x) = sum_z 1[x precedes z] (1 - q(z))
likelihood_branch.back_cost: C_back(x) = sigmoid(omega) * sum_{z != x} 1[x precedes z] q(z)
likelihood_branch.state_update: q(y)=1; q(x) *= (1 - sigmoid(omega)) for x downstream of y
likelihood_branch.not: uniform-frontier (beta would not multiply a utility term)

numerics.exponent_stabilisation: row-wise max subtraction before exp; cancels in the normalisation

dimensions.note: Stage 6D had K = 1 skill and oracle labels; Stage 6E has K = 3 reusable skills whose labels are latent

fixed_in_stage_6e.q_0: zeros(m), reset at the start of EVERY candidate block
fixed_in_stage_6e.tau: does not exist in this model (inherited from Stage 6D)

pi_P.why: they belong to the registered final target: targets.log_target_segmentation takes log_pi and log_transition, and transitions.py carries the conjugate updates Stage 3 validated. They were absent from Stage 6D only because K = 1 left no path prior to infer.
pi_P.update: frozen Stage 3 conjugate Dirichlet updates (transitions.dirichlet_posterior_params / sample_transition_matrix)
pi_P.self_transition_note: transitions.allowed_next(h, K) excludes h and the sampled diagonal is exactly 0, so adjacent segments must carry different skills and a segmentation that repeats a label across a boundary has log target -inf. Registered in the parent, not chosen here.

segmentation_kernel.reused: proposals.LocalMoveKernel — proposal_distribution, proposal_prob, sample_proposal and mh_local_step are used unchanged
segmentation_kernel.why_it_had_to_change: proposals.compatible_skills requires the block's CPA multiset to equal the skill's role multiset, so a legal Stage 5 block is a permutation of its skill's roles visiting each exactly once. The recurrent model is defined by repeats — lambda_rep and lambda_back exist because roles recur — so under that predicate NO recurrent block is compatible with any skill and every neighbourhood would be empty.
segmentation_kernel.hastings_ratio: unchanged: log q(S'->S) - log q(S->S') from the Stage 5 neighbourhood counting, never assumed symmetric

structural_model.latent: U in R^{m x d} continuous latent utility matrix
structural_model.induced_order: h(U): i > j iff U[i,r] > U[j,r] for every r; the intersection of the d column orderings
structural_model.legality: every real U induces a legal strict partial order; no acyclicity check exists or is needed
structural_model.mcmc_state: U itself (continuous); the poset is a derived label
structural_model.prior: rows iid Normal(0, Sigma_rho), Sigma_rho = (1-rho) I_d + rho 11^T
structural_model.rho_is: correlation between the d latent COLUMNS within a row; rows are iid. Not a row covariance -- that would need a matrix-normal prior
structural_model.rho_dependent_normaliser: -(m/2) log|Sigma_rho|, present in log_u_prior; cancels in a U update at fixed rho, does NOT cancel in a rho update at fixed U
structural_model.combinatorial_normaliser_reason: the prior is a density on R^{m x d}, not a score over a set of partial orders, so no sum over legal posets arises

frozen_config.starting_scales_note: the frozen Stage 6D2 scales, used ONLY as the pilot's centre. A target with latent (S, z) is a different target and carries no efficiency guarantee.
